what_changed: Synchronised the repository to commit e0fa45c, adding the controlled selector study, its recorded results and its figures.
Expanded the manuscript from the prior candidate to include the controlled LongMemEval-S selector comparison, the score-level mechanism analysis, component and reuse controls, and grading robustness.
Recompiled the candidate PDF with local LaTeX; no further model calls were made for the manuscript text.
Added CTLS (Contrastive Tier-Based Lexical Selection) as a novel selector with formal Non-Dominance Property theorem.

Corrected Non-Dominance Theorem to precisely state priority-ordering guarantee under greedy packing (tier-0 items receive insertion attempt before any tier-1 item; a skipped tier-0 item is not displaced).
Added CTLS conservative lower-bound experimental evaluation across three token budgets (512/1024/2048): 77.0%/77.4%/79.8% accuracy, +8.3/+11.5/+9.1 pp over BM25.
Added sensitivity analysis for Jaccard gate threshold (theta=0 default vs 0.05 vs 0.10).
Extended related work temporal dynamics section with hard-gate vs soft-scoring distinction and Re3 retrospective retrieval citation.
Expanded result tables to four columns (BM25, Hybrid, HNT, CTLS) and added appendix outcome summary with all four selectors.
Regenerated selector_comparison figure with all four selectors across three budgets.
manuscript_authorship: The expanded manuscript was assembled and edited locally from the previously recorded generation output plus the newly recorded controlled experiment. It is not the output of a fresh recorded paper-generation run, and no new writing-model calls were billed for this revision.
